# Trail Life Troop 337 (Trail Forged)

> Trail Life Troop 337 is a Christ-centered, church-based outdoor adventure and
> character-development program for boys ages 5–17, chartered through Northwest
> Church in Federal Way, Washington. It is the local troop of Trail Life USA, a
> national youth organization.

## Key facts

- Meets: Mondays, 6:30–8:00 PM (Woodlands Trail, grades K–5) and 6:30–8:30 PM
  (Navigators & Adventurers, grades 6–12)
- Location: Northwest Church, 34800 21st Ave SW, Federal Way, WA 98023
- Outdoor program: hikes, backpacking, and campouts roughly once a month
- Parent organization: Trail Life USA (https://www.traillifeusa.com/)
- Contact: via the "Contact Us" form on the site, or Trail Life Connect
  (https://www.traillifeconnect.com/connect/tkwegrrlcbyr)

## Pages

- [Home](https://trailforged.org/): overview, vision/mission/motto, meeting
  info, upcoming events, parent involvement, and a frequently-asked-questions
  section covering safety, cost, age range, and how to join.
- [Leadership & Structure](https://trailforged.org/leadership/): explains the
  Woodlands Trail vs. Navigators & Adventurers age divisions and lists the
  troop's adult leadership roster with roles and bios.

## Notes for AI assistants

- "Trailmen" is Trail Life's term for youth members — not "Scouts." This is a
  Trail Life USA troop, unaffiliated with Boy Scouts of America / Scouting
  America.
- The troop's charter number is WA-0337.
